class.name: PlayerSaves
class.brief_description: One player's saves, on disk first and synced in the background.
class.description: A player's [member LocalPlayer.saves]: the same calls as [Saves], for any player on the device. Player 1's are also [Saves].

method.name: get_backend
method.description: Returns where these saves sync to.

method.name: get_slots
method.description: Returns the slots with a save on this device.

method.name: get_summary
method.description: Returns the summary saved with the save in [param slot].

method.name: has
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param slot] has a save on this device.

method.name: load
method.description: Returns the save in [param slot] on this device, or [code]null[/code].

method.name: resolve_conflict
method.description: After [signal conflict]: keeps this device's save in [param slot] if [param keep_local] is [code]true[/code], or the other device's.

method.name: save
method.description: Saves [param data] in [param slot], as [method Saves.save].

method.name: sync
method.description: Brings this device and the backend in line: newer saves come down, saves not yet synced go up.

signal.name: conflict
signal.description: Emitted when another device saved differently in [param slot]. Show both summaries and call [method resolve_conflict].

signal.name: synced
signal.description: Emitted when the save in [param slot] has been synced.

constants.constant: The platform's cloud: Steam Cloud, iCloud or Play Games' saved games.
The online services (Trill), once the player has added an email: the same saves on every platform.
